theorem lg_target {β : Type u_1} [LinearOrder β] {t : ℕ → β} (ht_mono : StrictMono t) (ht_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto t Filter.atTop Filter.atTop) {x : β} (hx : t 0 < x) : ∃ n, t n < x ∧ x ≤ t (n + 1) := by
  let n := classical.some (Filter.exists_lt_of_tendsto_atTop ht_tendsto x)
  let hlt := classical.some_spec (Filter.exists_lt_of_tendsto_atTop ht_tendsto x)
  let hle := by
    intro hnx
    contrapos! hnx
    apply ht_mono
    exact le_of_lt hnx
  exact ⟨hlt, hle⟩
